paragraphs: Trainline’s mission to connect millions to greener journeys mirrors my passion for building tools that simplify complex data flows for end‑users. I built a tool‑calling LLM agent for a multi‑omics cancer research platform, using LangChain, AWS Bedrock and Claude Haiku 4.5, delivering gene alias resolution, scoring‑methodology explanation and dataset provenance. I also proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python for a Madrid‑based product start‑up, employing FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI, and presented it in a live stakeholder demo. I have not used Power BI yet, but I am eager to apply my data‑engineering skills to your analytics stack. Could we schedule a brief call so I can walk you through how my agentic tool framework could enhance Trainline’s data insights?
